Package client

Class CertifiedWorkerController

java.lang.Object
client.CertifiedWorkerController
public class CertifiedWorkerController extends Object
The CertifiedWorkerController class serves as the controller for the Certified Worker interface in the client application. It handles user interactions for certified workers, such as editing the menu and exiting the application.

This controller interacts with the server to manage data related to the certified worker, such as the menu they are authorized to edit. It also manages the user's session and ensures proper disconnection when the user exits.

Example usage:

 
 CertifiedWorkerController controller = new CertifiedWorkerController();
 controller.setClient(clientInstance);
 controller.setUser(currentUser);
